Privacy notice

A narrow, practical privacy notice for business enquiries.

This notice reflects the current contact-led website and the limited personal information used to respond to business enquiries.

Information you may provide

When you email Phull Insights, you may provide your name, work contact details, organisation and information about your enquiry. Do not send patient data, special-category personal data or confidential operational files in an initial enquiry.

Why it may be used

Information may be used to respond to your enquiry, assess whether the requested work is a fit, manage a business relationship and meet legal or professional obligations. Any later client-data processing is governed by engagement-specific terms and controls.

Sharing, retention and security

Personal information is shared only with service providers needed to operate the business, under appropriate terms, and retained only as long as needed for the enquiry, relationship or applicable obligations.

Your rights and contact

To ask about information held about you, request correction or raise a privacy concern, email hello@phullinsights.com. You may also raise a concern with the UK Information Commissioner.
